messages:
maya-support: Ticket INC-12345 from NovaScope — customer reports two charges for today's auto-renew. One PO invoice and one card charge. Screenshot attached. Escalating to billing.
devin-billing: Can you paste the invoice/payment IDs and a brief timeline? any webhook payloads or logs?
maya-support: Invoice INV-9876 (issued 2026-02-18T08:12:45Z). Card payment PAY-55566 (2026-02-18T08:13:10Z). Customer says PO was submitted first, then they manually charged card when they thought the PO failed. Webhook log snippet below:
```
POST /webhooks/po.updated 2026-02-18T08:12:45Z
payload: { "po_id": "PO-2011", "status": "paid", "invoice_id": "INV-9876", "total": "1200.00", "tax": "120.00" }
```
devin-billing: Thanks. Do we have the invoice-creation request that followed? specifically whether an Idempotency-Key header was present.
maya-support: From our internal request logs:
```
POST /api/invoices 2026-02-18T08:12:46Z
headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }
body: { "customer_id": "CUST-6644", "billing_period": "2026-02", "auto_pay": true, "amount": "1320.00" }
# Note: no Idempotency-Key present
```
kai-payments: I've pulled the ledger. Two settled entries: INV-9876 (linked to PO) and PAY-55566 (card). Our retry job for card payments triggered almost simultaneously. Logs show: webhook processed and created invoice row, but the retry job queried "no invoice found" because transaction hadn't committed yet, then created a second invoice. We don't have a DB uniqueness constraint on (customer_id, billing_period, plan_id) so duplicate invoice rows are allowed.
jules-engineer: I reproduced in staging by sending `po.updated` then firing the payment retry immediately. Confirmed race that produces duplicate invoice. Quick mitigation: (1) require Idempotency-Key on invoice creation, (2) add DB unique index to prevent duplicates, and (3) make retry job fetch-or-create inside a serializable transaction. I'll open a PR for the schema + retry change.
sara-sales: Customer is pretty upset. Can we refund the card payment and issue a credit note for the duplicate? Also let's offer 1 month free for goodwill.
devin-billing: I'll take payments. Refund command (using payments API):
```
POST /payments/refund
{ "payment_id": "PAY-55566", "amount": "1320.00", "reason": "duplicate_charge" }
```
devin-billing: Refund initiated — gateway refund id `r_1Gx9AbCk` — pending settlement (should clear in 3-5 business days). Created credit note CN-1009 for INV-9876 (amount 1320.00) and applied as account credit. Marked both invoices `investigating` and paused retries for CUST-6644.
ops-bot: deploy_notice: branch `fix/invoice-uniqueness` merged. Scheduled deploy to prod 2026-02-19 02:00 UTC. Auto-rollback on errors enabled.
jules-engineer: PR #342 created with DB unique index + idempotency-key validation + updated retry logic. Will backport hotfix if needed. Also adding an alert for duplicate-invoice creations.
maya-support: Customer emailed update: refund in progress, credit note applied, 1-month credit added manually. Customer replied "thanks, appreciate the quick action". I'll close INC-12345 after refund completes. Thanks everyone :pray:
